name: kimi-in-claude
description: Call OpenAI Kimi from Claude Code for delegation, review, and second opinions.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate to Kimi, review changes, and get second opinions.
interface.longDescription: kimi-in-claude lets Claude Code call the OpenAI Kimi CLI for an independent second opinion, structured code review, and delegated coding tasks. Delegation runs in an isolated git worktree and returns a reviewable diff that is never applied to your working tree. Read-only by default.
defaultPrompt: Get a second opinion from Kimi on this approach.
Have Kimi review my current changes.
Delegate this task to Kimi and show me the proposed diff.
